question: Why was the march started?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage states that the Dandi March was started to protest the British law that taxed salt.
 
• Salt being a basic necessity, Gandhi considered it unfair for people to pay tax on it.
 
• Other options like supporting education, celebrating independence, or fighting a war are not mentioned in the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Supporting education – not related to the Dandi March context.
 
• **Option 3:** Celebrating independence – India had not yet gained independence in 1930.
 
• **Option 4:** Fighting a war – the movement was non-violent, so this is incorrect.
